conclusion.sharpestStatement: The single undetected state is `empty`, and `empty` is the DEFAULT state: experiments/upstream-cache/ is gitignored at .gitignore:46 and is absent from any fresh clone. In the state that every clean clone and every CI run would encounter, BOTH the generated gate and the test suite report success while zero external bytes have been verified.
conclusion.creditWhereDue: The test's all-or-none rule ('source cache must be complete or absent') and its per-artifact byte check are sound design. The defect is not that the test is weak when files are present; it is that absence is accepted as success.
